exact_target: For epsilon>0 identify the EXISTING regularInverseGeneratorCutoff P epsilon with cfc F_epsilon (regularSpectralResolvent P), F_epsilon(z)=ofReal(z.re / max(min(1,epsilon),1+(epsilon-1)*z.re)). Prove global continuity from the positive clamped denominator and equality to 1/(epsilon+exp(-kappa)) at z=sigmoid(kappa). Use original graph_iff and inverse-cutoff graph_iff to identify candidate Y through (Yx,x-epsilonYx) in the SAME graph. This avoids a new inverse of I+(epsilon-1)R or a new shifted scalar multiplier. Then consume the already proved P(R), cfc membership and standard CFC.sqrt bridges to obtain the SAME CFC.sqrt B_epsilon right action on ALL n_nu. Consumer: norm identity for the bounded positive cut perturbations of the SAME scalar weight. Do not claim their limit, monotonicity or traciality in this target.

providers.name: regularInverseGeneratorCutoff
providers.statement:
def regularInverseGeneratorCutoff (P : SiteProfile) (ε : ℝ) :
    RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P) →L[ℂ] RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)

providers.name: regularInverseGeneratorCutoff_graph_iff
providers.statement:
theorem regularInverseGeneratorCutoff_graph_iff (P : SiteProfile) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε)
    (x y : RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)) :
    (x,y) ∈ (regularPositiveGenerator P).graph ↔
      regularInverseGeneratorCutoff P ε (y+(ε : ℂ) • x) = x

providers.name: regularPositiveGenerator_graph_iff
providers.statement:
theorem regularPositiveGenerator_graph_iff (P : SiteProfile)
    (x y : RegularHilbert (TowerHilbert P)) :
    (x,y) ∈ (regularPositiveGenerator P).graph ↔
      ∀ᵐ ξ ∂volume, ((regularSpectralCoordinates P).symm y) ξ =
        (Real.exp (-(2*Real.pi*ξ)) : ℂ) •
          ((regularSpectralCoordinates P).symm x) ξ

providers.name: regularSpectralResolvent_right
providers.statement:
theorem regularSpectralResolvent_right (P : SiteProfile) :
    (⟨regularSpectralResolvent P,regularSpectralResolvent_mem P⟩ :
      (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) ∈ scalarPolarRightAlgebra P

providers.name: scalarRightAction_cfc
providers.statement:
theorem scalarRightAction_cfc (P : SiteProfile)
    (b : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra)
    (hb : b ∈ scalarPolarRightAlgebra P) (f : ℂ → ℂ) :
    ∃ hf : cfc f b.val ∈ regularCoreAlgebra P,
      (⟨cfc f b.val,hf⟩ : (regularCoreAlgebra P).toStarSubalgebra) ∈
        scalarPolarRightAlgebra P

providers.name: realScalarMultiplier_cfc_ae
providers.statement:
theorem realScalarMultiplier_cfc_ae (g : ℝ → ℝ) (hg : Continuous g)
    (h0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ g x) (h1 : ∀ x, g x ≤ 1)
    (f : ℂ → ℂ) (hf : Continuous f) (u : RegularHilbert H) :
    cfc f (realScalarMultiplier g hg h0 h1) u =ᵐ[volume]
      fun x => f (g x : ℂ) • u x

providers.name: factor_positive_sqrt_mem
providers.statement:
theorem factor_positive_sqrt_mem (P : SiteProfile)
    (A : (theFactorObject P).toStarSubalgebra) (hA : 0 ≤ A) :
    CFC.sqrt (A : TowerHilbert P →L[ℂ] TowerHilbert P) ∈
      (theFactorObject P).toStarSubalgebra

providers.name: sqrt_eq_real_sqrt
providers.statement:
lemma sqrt_eq_real_sqrt (a : A) (ha : 0 ≤ a := by cfc_tac) :
    CFC.sqrt a = cfcₙ Real.sqrt a

providers.name: cfcₙ_eq_cfc
cfc_real_eq_complex
providers.statement:
lemma cfc_real_eq_complex {a : A} (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ha : IsSelfAdjoint a := by cfc_tac) :
    cfc f a = cfc (fun x ↦ f x.re : ℂ → ℂ) a
